decisions.question: Classify the amend of flutter-binding@v2's Delivery paragraph (G20 moves from nidana.flutter.6 to nidana.flutter.8; nidana.flutter.5 runs beside .6 and then .8; the consumer sentence names .8 for NidanaModule) against the contract's Breaking list: compatible within v2, or a breaking amend for the human (DEC-686)?

options.label: Compatible: apply within v2
options.consequence: The Delivery paragraph and produced_by change; no version bump, no migration note; consumers' edges and every guarantee, case and fixture stay as they are.

options.label: Breaking: report as a skill stop for DEC-686
options.consequence: The drain stops and the orchestrator decides; a v3 would be out of proportion to a phase reassignment no consumer relies on.

decisions.why: The Breaking list names declarations, finality, rendering and rebuilds, acquire and release, binding, derivations, Navigator effects, defaults, WidgetTestBus construction, shutdown ownership, which operation throws what, and moving to a breaking upstream version. It names no phase assignment: the Delivery paragraph states which producing phase first replays which guarantee, written by reconcile from the producer's plan (conventions, Contracts). No declaration, guarantee, case or fixture changes. Consumers wait on nidana.flutter.1 (nidana.tooling.codegen's contract edges) or nidana.flutter.7 (nidana.integration's hard edges); nidana.flutter.7 now depends on nidana.flutter.8, so its closure delivers G20 as before. No plan anywhere waits on nidana.flutter.6 for G20. The gates agree: nidana.flutter.6's --guarantee list omits G20, nidana.flutter.8's adds it, nidana.flutter.7 replays unrestricted. Precedent: flutter-binding v1 amendment (e) and S80's bus-api@v2 Delivery change were both compatible.
evidence: hsdd/spec/nidana.flutter.md D12, nidana.flutter.6/.7/.8 gates and Dependencies
